figures.caption: GBIF candidate host-occurrence record availability by species and country. Bars show mapping-ready public GBIF occurrence records retained after project QC. Counts describe record availability only; they are not estimates of host abundance, infection prevalence, sampling effort, or human risk.
figures.data_source: GBIF candidate rodent occurrence archive and mapping-readiness summaries
figures.disallowed_interpretation: host abundance, infection risk, human risk, spillover, causal inference
figures.uncertainty_definition: descriptive counts only; no uncertainty interval estimated

figures.caption: Non-spatial within-study Sin Nombre virus positivity summaries from public supplementary data for PMID 38236803. Points or bars show positive fractions among 738 rodent samples; error bars are Wilson 95% confidence intervals. The Any category counts unique samples positive by ELISA or qPCR. Public site codes are within-study labels only because GPS coordinates were excluded by the source authors.
figures.data_source: PLOS One public S1 Table for PMID 38236803
figures.denominator_or_n: 738 rodent samples; 20 public site codes; 27 species labels
figures.disallowed_interpretation: spatial suitability, host abundance, regional risk, spillover, human risk, causal inference
figures.uncertainty_definition: Wilson 95% confidence intervals for binomial proportions

figures.allowed_interpretation: model gate QC, failure diagnostics, and robustness assessment
figures.caption: Formal host-occurrence suitability gate diagnostics. Panels report spatial cross-validation AUC and Brier-score behavior for the bounded GBIF host-occurrence model and background/covariate sensitivity checks. Dashed reference lines mark predeclared decision thresholds. These diagnostics document why the environmental model gate remained blocked after QC.
figures.data_source: Formal environmental suitability model QC and background-sensitivity metrics
figures.denominator_or_n: 5 spatial folds; presence/background rows from formal environmental Phase 1
figures.disallowed_interpretation: validated suitability map, human risk map, abundance estimate, spillover, Rt, causal inference
figures.uncertainty_definition: fold-level diagnostic metrics; no inferential uncertainty interval estimated

figures.caption: Descriptive suitability pilot covariate scores for presence and background rows. Points show bounded descriptive suitability scores against selected environmental covariates. This is a QC visualization of a descriptive pilot and does not represent a validated formal risk or suitability model.
figures.data_source: GBIF descriptive suitability pilot prediction table
figures.disallowed_interpretation: human infection risk, formal host suitability, abundance, spillover, causal inference
figures.uncertainty_definition: point distribution only; no uncertainty interval estimated

figures.allowed_interpretation: public surveillance availability and aggregate count description
figures.caption: Public aggregate human hantavirus surveillance availability and summary counts. Non-geographic tile maps show 2023 CDC WONDER annual U.S. state counts and ECDC annual country totals summed from numeric monthly rows; gray tiles mark suppressed, unavailable, or non-numeric retained entries. The figure is a descriptive availability/count gate output and is not a risk map.
figures.data_source: CDC WONDER annual public aggregate rows and ECDC country-month surveillance rows
figures.denominator_or_n: 2023 panel rows from public aggregate surveillance exports
figures.disallowed_interpretation: incidence comparability, risk map, Rt, surveillance-ecology join, causal inference
figures.uncertainty_definition: descriptive aggregate counts only; suppressed/non-numeric entries are flagged rather than imputed

figures.caption: Non-geographic grid summary of GBIF record availability by country or area. The grid is sorted for compact source-coverage display and does not encode geographic adjacency. It describes public occurrence-record availability only and must not be read as host abundance or risk.
figures.denominator_or_n: 157 countries/areas represented in the GBIF mapping-readiness output
figures.disallowed_interpretation: geographic risk, abundance, infection burden, causal inference
figures.uncertainty_definition: descriptive counts only; no uncertainty interval estimated
